snippet.title: Outbound Release Date Trailer - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Outbound is a sustainability-focused survival game, and during the Spring Showcase, developers Square Glade Games revealed that it will be launching on April 23 for PC & Consoles. A demo is also out now on PlayStation and Xbox, so you can get behind the wheel ahead of launch.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2681030/Outbound/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
